name: mcp-atlassian-extended
description: Jira/Confluence MCP server (MCP 2026-07-28): sprints, boards, attachments; writes or read-only

jira_api_token.title: JIRA_API_TOKEN
jira_api_token.description: Jira Cloud API token, used with JIRA_USERNAME (basic auth)

jira_pat.title: JIRA_PAT
jira_pat.description: Jira personal access token for Data Center (aliases: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN, JIRA_TOKEN). Ignored when JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN are both set.

confluence_api_token.title: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
confluence_api_token.description: Confluence Cloud API token, used with CONFLUENCE_USERNAME (basic auth)

confluence_pat.title: CONFLUENCE_PAT
confluence_pat.description: Confluence personal access token for Data Center (aliases: CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN, CONFLUENCE_TOKEN). Confluence tools also require the Team Calendars add-on.

mcp_read_only.title: MCP_READ_ONLY
mcp_read_only.description: Locks the server read-only: write tools and write-workflow prompts are not listed and nothing lifts the lock at runtime. Shared name across the mcp-* servers; set it in the deployer's env
